The 4D-CHAINS assignments are then used to guide automated assignment of long-range NOEs and structure refinement in autoNOE-Rosetta.
answer: The 4D-CHAINS algorithm is an innovative approach used in medical imaging to analyze complex data sets, specifically focusing on the analysis of diffusion-weighted MRI images. This method aims to reconstruct high-resolution images from limited data, making it particularly useful in fields where detailed anatomical information is crucial, such as neuroimaging.
